title: When Does Experience Memory Help Closed-Loop LLM Driving Agents? A Controlled Evaluation with Resampled Warmup Pools, Token-Matched Fillers, and Audited Baselines
abstract: arXiv:2610.27714v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When does experience memory help a closed-loop LLM driving agent? Published gains cannot say, because the two factors we find to matter most, which warmup experiences the pool contains and what any injected tokens do to the prompt, are controlled in none of them. We answer with a controlled evaluation on one audited HighwayEnv testbed (1Hz, gpt-4o-mini for the decisive contrasts). We treat the warmup pool as a resampled random factor (ten disjoint pools) and add token-matched irrelevant-filler controls, oracle-certified diagnostics, caution-pricing metrics, and quantified audits of the baseline ports. The probe suite spans flat-text retrieval (a DiLu port), a single-frame grid port (RESPOND-inspired), our episodic temporal-graph memory, a retrieval-free consolidated rulebook, and a flat K-step observation-history baseline. Four findings follow, each a property of this testbed. (1) Headline memory gains belong to the warmup draw. The repo

translated_title: 经验记忆何时能帮助闭环LLM驾驶智能体？基于重采样预热池、令牌匹配填充器与审计基线的受控评估
translated_abstract: 经验记忆何时能帮助闭环LLM驾驶智能体？已发表的收益无法回答这一问题，因为我们发现最关键的两个因素——预热池中包含哪些预热经验、以及注入的令牌对提示词产生什么影响——在现有研究中均未被控制。我们通过在一个经过审计的HighwayEnv测试平台（1Hz，决定性对比使用gpt-4o-mini）上进行受控评估来回答这一问题。我们将预热池视为重采样的随机因素（十个互不相交的池），并加入令牌匹配的无关填充控制、经oracle认证的诊断、谨慎定价指标以及对基线移植版本的量化审计。探测套件涵盖平文本检索（DiLu移植版）、单帧网格移植版（受RESPOND启发）、我们的情景时间图记忆、无需检索的整合规则手册以及平铺的K步观察历史基线。由此得出四项发现，每项均为该测试平台的特性。(1) 报告中的记忆收益归属于预热抽样的运气。代码库……
tldr: 本研究通过在审计的HighwayEnv测试平台上控制预热池抽样与提示令牌两大混淆因素，发现经验记忆为闭环LLM驾驶智能体带来的表面收益主要来自预热经验池的随机抽样，而非记忆机制本身。
en_tdlr: Through a controlled evaluation on an audited HighwayEnv testbed that controls warmup-pool resampling and token injection as confounds, this study shows that headline experience-memory gains for closed-loop LLM driving agents stem mainly from the random warmup draw rather than the memory mechanism itself.
